{{Top|leg}}
'''The Gathering''' was an event celebrated by the [[Fyodoi]] of [[Fyodos]]. Every 190 days, the three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the planet came into conjunction, leading to a great feast attended by all the [[Chief/Legends|chiefs]] and [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] of the Fyodoi tribes, along with one hundred members of the tribe. Fyodoi also engaged in tests of strength and skill, and children took their rites of passage into adulthood.
